name: AP63205
description: Fixed 5 V, 2 A synchronous buck from up to 32 V in TSOT-23-6 with no feedback resistors, for servo/USB 5 V rails on 12–24 V robots.
notes: Fixed 5 V: FB pin connects straight to the output.
1.1 MHz with spread spectrum; 4.7 µH inductor in the datasheet circuit.

en.note: Internal 1.5 µA pull-up from VCC: leave open or tie to VIN for automatic start-up (EN is a high-voltage pin, abs max 35 V = VIN abs max DC). Precision threshold 1.18 V rising / 1.10 V falling typ; an extra 4 µA hysteresis current flows above threshold. Optional VIN UVLO divider R5 (VIN-EN) / R6 (EN-GND): R5 = (0.932*VON - VOFF)/4.1 µA, R6 = 1.1*R5/(VOFF - 1.1 V + 5.5 µA*R5). Optional EN-GND delay cap: Cd[nF] = 1.27 * tdelay[ms].

notes: Peak-current-mode, internally compensated, fixed 1.1 MHz with +/-6 % frequency spread spectrum; PFM at light load (22 µA Iq); 4 ms internal soft-start.

Inductor: L = VOUT*(VIN-VOUT)/(VIN*dIL*fSW) with dIL = 30-50 % of the 2 A MAXIMUM load current (not the actual load); 2.2-10 µH for most applications; DC/saturation rating >= 35 % above max load; DCR < 100 mOhm. Datasheet table: 5.0 V -> 4.7 µH, C1 10 µF, C2 2x22 µF, C3 100 nF.
Output cap: 22-68 µF ceramic sufficient for most applications (typical 2x22 µF). Transient: COUT > L*(IOUT + dIL/2)^2 / ((dV + VOUT)^2 - VOUT^2) (Eq. 10).
Input cap: ceramic >= 10 µF sufficient for most applications; RMS rating > half the max load current; place close to VIN/GND.
Current limit: HS peak 2.8 A typ (2.5 min / 3.1 max); LS valley 3.2 A typ. Hiccup after 2 ms at current limit, restart after 16 ms.
Dropout: when VIN nears VOUT the HS switch is held on for multiple cycles (effective duty ~100 %, LDO-like) with forced BST refresh; no max-duty or min-off-time number is specified.
VIN 3.8-32 V (abs max 35 V DC, 40 V for 400 ms); UVLO rising 3.5 V typ, 440 mV hysteresis.
Layout: VIN cap as close as possible; 2 oz copper top/bottom and a GND plane under the device recommended for 2 A.
design.pages: DS41326 Rev. 3-2 (Nov 2024). Pin functions & Fig. 1 typical app p2; abs max (EN 35 V, BST-SW 6 V, VIN 35 V) p4; EC table (VFB fixed 5.00 V, IPEAK_LIMIT 2.8 A, tON min 80 ns, EN 1.18/1.10 V, fSW 1100 kHz) p5; Fig. 21 fixed-output app p9; Enable & UVLO Eq. 1-2 p10, Eq. 3 & EN-to-VIN p11; Table 2/3 (L, C1, C2, C3) + inductor Eq. 7, 2.2-10 µH, dIL 30-50 % + input cap p13; output cap 22-68 µF Eq. 9-10 + bootstrap 100 nF + dropout p14; layout p15.

summary: 3.8–32 V in → 5 V fixed, 2 A, 1.1 MHz
